summary: Supplements frame-runtime-buildout-20260915-checker with a flake observed after it was written. On one run_all invocation the claims-and-editor-boundary suite exited 3221225477 (0xC0000005, access violation) with no test output, while every other run passed. Re-checked immediately: standalone 13/13 OK, run_all PASS, then six consecutive standalone runs all clean - one crash in roughly eight runs, not reproducible on demand. It is a process-level crash of the interpreter, not a failing assertion: the suite spawns seven nested python subprocesses to exercise the hook through its real exit-code contract, and the crash carried no traceback. Recorded rather than dismissed, because a suite that fails once in eight will eventually fail in front of someone who believes it. Suggested follow-up if it recurs: keep the subprocess path for the exit-code contract but reduce the spawn count by parameterizing one subprocess call over several payloads.
